source_faithful_statement: For a four-layer GeLU MLP, sampled NTK means using 100000 initializations agree closely with the finite-width corrected recursion at hidden widths above 20.
judge_wording_discrepancy: The imported judge wording says four-layer ReLU and 5e6 initializations. In v4, those describe the separate diagonal no-correction experiment in Figure 3; the recursion-correction experiment is GeLU with 1e5 NTK samples in Figure 2 and Appendix D.
pass_condition: At widths 32, 56, 100, and 220, every fresh diagonal and off-diagonal mean is closer to the pre-existing source-PDF first-order prediction than to infinite width, every residual is at most half the first-order signal, the median residual ratio is at most 0.25, and the infinite-width substitution fails.
